item.title: About
item.description:
Hobbyist engineer based in Southern California. I build things that fly, roll, spin, and occasionally catch fire. WAG Labs is where I document what I make.

Interests: RC aircraft, VTOL flight controllers, ArduPilot, Simulink, embedded C++, 3D printing, woodworking, PCB design.

item.title: Automated Top-Speed RC Car
item.description: First WAG Labs video — an ArduPilot-equipped RC car doing automated top-speed runs.

item.title: VTOL Hover Plane
item.description:
Overview

Designing and building a VTOL hover plane with a Simulink LQR attitude controller deployed to a Teensy 4.1 flight controller.

Simulation

Integrated with the RealFlight Evolution simulator via the FlightAxis SOAP API.
